scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm mobile:analyze && pnpm mobile:test
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/openapi packages/contracts/generated apps/mobile/packages/argent_api_client
scripts.contracts:generate: pnpm --filter @argent/api openapi:write && node packages/contracts/scripts/clean-generated.mjs && openapi-generator-cli generate && node packages/contracts/scripts/postprocess-dart.mjs && node packages/contracts/scripts/normalize-generated.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm audit:prod
